creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Detection reads agent state off the screen with per-agent rules (crates/muster-detect/manifests), so a harness update that changes its UI text breaks it: claude.toml already carries a spinner rule patched for Claude Code 2.1.228. amterp wants Muster built so harness updates do not break it (2026-09-27).

Direction: where a harness has a documented integration point, it reports its own state and that wins. For Claude Code that is its hooks (prompt submitted -> working, permission prompt -> blocked, turn stopped -> idle), sent through the daemon's existing Report request with a new state field. Screen rules stay as the fallback for harnesses without hooks and for panes where they are not installed, and a fresh self-report outranks them (MIP-3 section 8 currently says 'no hooks'; herdr's hook arbitration was not ported, so this is new design: say how a stale report expires and how the two sources hand over).

Also wanted: when the screen rules stop matching a known agent (identified, screen changing, no rule firing for a long stretch, or an agent version newer than the manifest was checked against), say so on the pane and in the daemon log rather than showing a confident wrong state. And an out-of-gate check that runs the current Claude Code against the manifest, so drift is found by us before a user.

Open: how the hooks get installed (a Claude Code plugin under extras/ that absorbs hooks.json, versus merging into settings). Related: done-unseen a_2XYi76eVz, facts a_2XQXk8sou.
title: Agent state from harness hooks first, screen rules as fallback
